About

§ 01

Nearly two decades in production, most of it spent where compliance, brand, and craft all have to hold up under deadline. Thirteen years at Core Laboratories building web tools, SQL-backed applications, and event A/V for a global reservoir-optimization brand. Now at Wells Fargo, running high-volume, regulated print production where every job has to clear quality control before it ships.

The thread running through it: taking a project from raw material — a script, a spec sheet, a stack of files — to a finished, working piece, whether that's a video edit, a responsive webpage, or a run of press proofs.
